tagline: Making the future work for everyone
hero_kpi_rationale: The key KPI is the target EBITA margin of 3 to 6%, as it reflects the structural transformation toward a more profitable and resilient business, despite a cyclical environment. It is the primary driver of shareholder value creation in the staffing sector.

kpis.name: Target EBITA Margin
kpis.explanation: Target operating profit margin over a full economic cycle.
kpis.description: The company targets an EBITA margin of 3 to 6% over the cycle, with an aspiration to reach the upper end of the range in favorable conditions.
kpis.signal: Ambition to reach the upper end in favorable environments

kpis.name: Net Debt
kpis.explanation: Total debt after deduction of available cash.
kpis.description: Net debt stands at EUR 2.29 billion as of end-2025, down EUR 186 million year-on-year.
kpis.signal: Reduction of EUR 186 million over one year, signaling financial discipline

kpis.name: Gross Debt
kpis.explanation: Total amount of debt before deduction of cash.
kpis.description: Gross debt decreased by EUR 280 million over the year, reaching EUR 2.576 billion.
kpis.signal: Decline of EUR 280 million over one year

kpis.name: Dividend Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Portion of adjusted earnings distributed to shareholders as dividend.
kpis.description: The payout ratio is 46%, in line with the company's dividend policy.
kpis.signal: Within the target range of 40 to 50%

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount of dividend paid per share.
kpis.description: The proposed dividend is CHF 1.00 per share, with an option for share-based payment at a 6% discount.
kpis.signal: Maintenance of dividend level despite the environment

kpis.name: Target Leverage Ratio
kpis.explanation: Target ratio of net debt to EBITDA for 2027.
kpis.description: The goal is to reach or fall below 1.5x Net Debt / EBITDA by end-2027.

kpis.name: Akkodis Target Margin
kpis.explanation: Target operating margin for the Akkodis segment once the turnaround is complete.
kpis.description: Akkodis targets a 10% margin, similar to LHH, once the turnaround is complete.

kpis.name: LHH Actual Margin
kpis.explanation: Current operating margin of the LHH segment.
kpis.description: The LHH segment delivers a margin of approximately 10%, demonstrating its resilience and profitability.

ai_positioning.summary: Adecco integrates AI into its Future@Work strategy, including AI-savvy board members and a clear technology roadmap. AI is viewed as a lever for efficiency and transformation in HR services.
evidence: Appointment of board members with technology and digital expertise
Mention of a 'pioneering AI agenda' supported by governance
Future@Work strategy focused on digital transformation and AI
